I have carefully reviewed the entire paper text. The paper discusses glasses in the system P2O5–CaO–Na2O–{Al2O3} and references samples GI, GI/1, GI/2, GII, GII/1, GII/2, but **no composition table with specific oxide amounts (mol% or wt%) is provided** in the extracted text. The tables present NMR parameters (chemical shifts, Qn fractions, Al coordination percentages), not glass compositions.

There are no material-composition entries (oxide formula + numeric value + unit) to extract from this
